description: Implementation of the TaskList class for managing a collection of Task objects, including methods for task retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and reordering.

classes.name: TaskList
classes.description: A class that manages a list of tasks, providing methods for task manipulation such as addition, deletion, filtering, and reordering.

methods.name: const std::vector<Task> & all() const
methods.description: Returns a constant reference to all tasks stored in the list.

methods.name: std::vector<Task> getTasks(Filter filter,const std::string & search) const
methods.description: Retrieves tasks filtered by completion status and an optional search term.

methods.name: void validateTitle(const std::string & title)
methods.description: Validates that a task title is not empty and does not exceed the character limit.

methods.name: Task & createTask(const std::string & title,const std::string & description,const std::string & dueDate)
methods.description: Creates a new task with provided details and adds it to the list.

methods.name: bool updateTask(const Task & updated)
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by its ID.

methods.name: bool toggleComplete(uint64_t id)
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task by its ID.

methods.name: bool deleteTask(uint64_t id)
methods.description: Removes a task from the list based on its ID.

methods.name: bool moveUp(uint64_t id)
methods.description: Moves a task up in the list order.

methods.name: bool moveDown(uint64_t id)
methods.description: Moves a task down in the list order.

methods.name: void clear()
methods.description: Clears all tasks from the list.

methods.name: void setAll(std::vector<Task> tasks)
methods.description: Replaces current tasks with a new list of tasks and recalculates the next ID.

methods.name: int indexOf(uint64_t id) const
methods.description: Finds the index of a task by its ID.
